name: Impeccable (impeccable.style)
evidence: GitHub API via MCP 2026-10-10: pbakaus/impeccable 79,261 stars, Apache-2.0, created 2025-11-16, pushed 2026-10-09. impeccable.style/docs fetched 2026-10-10: install via `npx impeccable install`, `/plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable`, or `npx skills add pbakaus/impeccable`; Claude Code build ships hooks + subagent + automatic design-check detector; ~25 commands (/impeccable, shape, audit, critique, animate, polish, distill, clarify, typeset, colorize, layout, harden, document, extract, generate, init, live...). Author Paul Bakaus.
what_it_does: A frontend-design skill set for coding agents: design vocabulary, PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md context files, focused refine commands and an automatic 'AI slop' detector that runs on edit hooks.
claimed_in_videos: adam_ha_yes: 'the missing design vocabulary for agents', one of 7 tools that make vibe-coded pages look good. chase_ai_: layer it on top of a cloned site for polish.
reality_check: Holds. Largest and most actively maintained design skill on GitHub, free, has real tooling (hooks, detector, variations) rather than a prompt dump. It does not design for you; it constrains Claude so output stops looking templated.
why: Design slop is the single most visible weakness of Claude Code-built products. This is the highest-leverage, zero-cost fix and it installs in two minutes into every repo Haji touches.
how_to_adopt: In each project folder: `npx impeccable install` (choose Claude Code), then in Claude Code run `/impeccable init` to write PRODUCT.md (audience, goals). Then `/impeccable polish <page>` on an existing screen and compare before/after.
risks: Adds context tokens on every UI task; keep the detector hooks only on frontend repos. Do not stack it with Taste Skill by default (two competing rulebooks). Apache-2.0, no lock-in.

name: Taste Skill (tasteskill.dev)
evidence: GitHub API via MCP 2026-10-10: Leonxlnx/taste-skill 94,317 stars, MIT, created 2026-02-19, pushed 2026-10-09. Site fetched 2026-10-10: 13 skills in one install (`npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste-skill`), default `design-taste-frontend` v2 marked experimental; style variants (soft/minimalist/brutalist), redesign-skill, image-gen skills, stitch-skill with DESIGN.md export. Site carries paid sponsors (Sidrune AI etc.) and promotes the team's TasteCode desktop app (free beta).
what_it_does: Open-source SKILL.md rule set ('anti-slop frontend framework') with typography/spacing/color/motion rules, brief inference, dark-mode protocol and a pre-flight checklist for agents.
claimed_in_videos: adam_ha_yes: 'gives Claude actual taste'. chase_ai_: second design skill to layer on.
reality_check: Exists, huge, MIT. Overlaps almost entirely with Impeccable in scope; v2 is self-described experimental. Nobody has demonstrated that loading both at once is better; mechanically they are two rulebooks with different bans, so expect contradictions and more context burn.
why: Worth one A/B against Impeccable on a real landing page so Haji picks a house default. Its style sub-skills (soft/minimalist/brutalist) are handy when a client wants a specific mood.
how_to_adopt: `npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill design-taste-frontend` in a scratch project; build the same page with Impeccable and with Taste; keep one as default, keep the other installed but invoke it only by name.
risks: Experimental v2 rule wording changes; sponsor-driven site; conflicting instructions if auto-loaded alongside Impeccable.

name: getdesign.md / Awesome DESIGN.md (VoltAgent)
evidence: GitHub API via MCP 2026-10-10: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md 120,134 stars, 13,397 forks, MIT, created 2026-03-31, pushed 2026-10-05. getdesign.md fetched 2026-10-10: '550+ DESIGN.md analyses', 'Follows Google's official DESIGN.md spec', maintained by VoltAgent; also sells Catalog Pass, Private DESIGN.md commissions, Pro templates, starter kits, and runs an affiliate program (prices JS-rendered, not captured).

claimed_in_videos: adam_ha_yes: 'steal any famous design system'.
reality_check: The files are fan-made analyses of public sites, not official brand tokens. Great as a starting brief; they are not licensed brand systems and shipping an Apple/Stripe look-alike is a trade-dress risk. The GitHub repo is free; the site upsells.

how_to_adopt: Clone https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md, copy one DESIGN.md (e.g. Linear or Vercel for apps) to your repo root, edit colors/fonts to your brand, reference it from CLAUDE.md ('Follow DESIGN.md for all UI').
risks: Trade dress if copied verbatim for a public product; fonts named in files (SF Pro, Inter etc.) have their own licenses; site has affiliate/upsell motives.

name: Google Stitch / Opal / Flow / AI Studio
evidence: Opal page fetched 2026-10-10: 'Opal is graduating out of Labs on November 17, 2026... Active workflows will no longer run after this date.' Stitch: free Google Labs beta, originator of the DESIGN.md spec, daily/monthly generation caps that change (third-party). Flow: Veo video, free 50 credits/day, Pro $19.99 for 1,000 credits, Ultra tiers (third-party). AI Studio: free UI, API billed per token.
what_it_does: Stitch: UI design generator that exports React and DESIGN.md. Opal: no-code AI workflow builder (shutting down as a Labs product). Flow: Veo video studio. AI Studio: Gemini playground and API keys.
claimed_in_videos: Not directly named in the liked videos (DESIGN.md spec comes from Stitch).
reality_check: Stitch is the only one relevant to design; it is free but capped and outputs generic React. Opal is ending. Flow/AI Studio are media/API tools, not design tools.
why: Stitch can produce a DESIGN.md for a brand-new product in minutes if Haji has nothing to start from; otherwise Claude's `/design` does the same inside his stack. AI Studio only for the Gemini image key.
how_to_adopt: Optional: generate a screen in Stitch, export DESIGN.md, hand to Claude Code. Do not build on Opal.

name: '$10k website in one prompt' (Fable 5 max effort + Higgsfield MCP)
evidence: nateherkai and forcceee_ use the same script, same example sites ('aicm', 'Camply/Comply', 'Nebula X'), comment/DM-gated 'prompt pack', no on-screen build. chase_ai_'s full walkthrough (the only demonstrated build) needs a reference URL, a clone skill, a 10-45 min clone, a remix pass, hero-video generation and multiple fix-up prompts. Higgsfield media is paid per clip (see above).
what_it_does: Prompt template: 'Build a website for my [business]. Use [reference URL] as visual inspiration' with high effort and an asset-generation MCP.
claimed_in_videos: 'Claude Fable 5 can build websites people charge $10,000 for', 'one prompt, one award-winning website', 'website creators are no longer needed'.
reality_check: Does not hold as stated. The reusable kernel is real: reference URL + design skill + high effort + generated assets yields a strong first draft. Getting to 'award-winning' is iterative, costs tokens and credits, and the showcased sites are generic AI demos, not paid client work.
why: Haji should keep the prompt pattern (reference + DESIGN.md + skill) and ignore the funnel; heavy 3D-scroll sites also hurt performance and conversion for real products.
how_to_adopt: Use the pattern inside the stack below: `/design` or `/impeccable` with a reference URL and your DESIGN.md, iterate 3-5 times, generate at most one hero asset.
risks: Token cost at max effort on multi-page builds; chasing comment-gated 'prompt packs'.

name: Agency UX checklist (skeletons, autofill, optimistic UI, save state, error handling)
evidence: Standard, well-documented UX patterns; no tool to verify. Compatible with any React data layer (TanStack Query / SWR mutations support optimistic updates and rollback).
what_it_does: Five product-polish rules: skeleton loaders over spinners, prefill known fields, optimistic updates with rollback, persist drafts/filters/carts, human error messages with retry.
claimed_in_videos: jploftofficial: features a 10-year agency puts in almost every app; skeletons make apps 'feel 100x faster'.
reality_check: Holds; these are exactly the items vibe-coded apps skip.
why: Zero cost, applies to every Haji app, and encodes once into CLAUDE.md so every new screen gets them by default.
how_to_adopt: Add a 'UI standards' block to CLAUDE.md: skeleton loaders mirroring layout; prefill from session/profile; optimistic mutations with rollback via TanStack Query; persist form drafts and filters (localStorage/URL); every fetch wrapped with friendly error + retry; never show raw API errors.
risks: Optimistic UI needs idempotent server actions; drafts in localStorage must exclude sensitive data.
